# Hartsmere Rigging - gear workspace

Shared folder for the lifting gear store.

- rigging/  sling cards from the test house
- lifts/  lift plans waiting on review

turns.prompt: A rigger at Hartsmere asked what the safe working load on a sling tag means; it is the load the sling broke at under test divided by a factor of safety. Sling SL-14 broke at 12,400 newtons and the house applies a factor of 5. Give its safe working load in newtons. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
